description:
Create many new listings in one call, one row each (category, title, price in VND, district, optional text, and photos by create_listing's rules), e.g. to move a stock list onto eno.

Rows are independent: a bad row fails alone, with its reason (create_listing's rules: a phone number in the title or contact details in the text refused, long text shortened). When the account may not publish at all, nothing is created. A row repeating an active listing of this shop, or an earlier row of the call, fails as a duplicate.

Returns `created` and `failed` counts and `results`, one per row in the order sent: its `row` number, the new `id`, your `external_id` and the `error`, if any. To keep eno matched to your system by your own ids, use sync_catalogue.

listings.description: The new listings, one row each; every row succeeds or fails on its own

categorySlug.description: Category slug: vehicles, rentals, property, moving-sale, furniture-appliances, electronics, fashion-beauty, sports, baby-kids, books-stationery, hobbies-sports, pets, jobs, services, community-events, tickets-travel, food-drink (rooms and flats to let: rentals)

condition.description: The item's condition: "new", "like_new" or "used" (other words are kept as written); ignored for a job. Leave it out when it does not apply

description.description: The listing page's text, in the seller's words: what it is, its state and what comes with it. Leave it out for no text

district.description: Where the item is, as a district or area buyers recognise, e.g. "Thảo Điền, Thủ Đức". A new listing needs it (else `location_required`)

externalId.description: Your own id for this listing, such as your SKU, echoed back in the results so you can match each row to your system; leave it out if you have none

images.description: Photos as public image URLs, in display order, the cover first; eno copies them. Show the item from different angles: a listing with too few is refused with `photos_min` (a service with none: `photo_required`). On a new listing, leave it out only for a job

price.description: The asking price in Vietnamese đồng (VND); for a job, its monthly salary in VND

title.description: The headline buyers see first: the item and what sets it apart, e.g. "Honda Vision 2022, 8,000 km"

name: bulk_create_listings

created.description: How many rows became new listings; with failed it adds up to the number of rows you sent

failed.description: How many rows were refused and created nothing; each one's reason is in its result's error

results.description: One result for every row you sent, in the same order, saying whether it was created and why not

error.description: Why the row failed, in words to show the seller; fix that row and send it again on its own. null when it was created

external_id.description: Your own id for the row, echoed back so you can match it to your system; null when the row carried none

id.description: The new listing's id when the row was created, for get_listing or update_listing; null when the row failed (see error)

row.description: The row's position in the list you sent, counting from 1, so you can match each result to the row it is about

title: Create listings in bulk
